title: LOOK: Sotto turns over clean office to Gatchalian
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Contributed photos showed that the office that former Senate President Vicente Sotto III will turn over to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian was clean and seemingly untouched.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Contributed photos showed that the office that former Senate President Vicente Sotto III will turn over to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian was clean and seemingly untouched. Except for what appeared to be an internet cable, no part of the office had been dismantled. Gatchalian’s soon-to-be office still had a 10-seat conference table,
